data.content_ref: inline:The centralized-resilience claim of SRC_004 contradicts the underspecification result of SRC_006: SRC_004 treats strictly more redundancy as sufficient for the large service, while SRC_006 shows it is only conditional on lower internal coupling; the contradiction is refuted if SRC_004's diversity provision is shown to strictly imply lower internal coupling, collapsing the two claims into compatible special cases.
